one_liner: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) is a broad Graph API REST surface. Direct use is self-serve with system-user tokens. Multi-customer use needs Tech Provider status, App Review with Advanced access and Embedded Signup. An official Meta MCP is likely but not confirmed by the supplied pages.
auth_notes: Graph API calls use Bearer access tokens. Direct developers generate a system user token in Business Settings, which is a static secret (API_KEY). Partners are told to use business tokens, and Embedded Signup authorizes the partner's app to access client assets (OAuth-style, Meta Login). The pages do not detail the OAuth flow itself, so OAUTH2 as primary is medium confidence.
access_notes: The pages say apps that won't be used by other businesses follow the Cloud API Get Started guide, so single-business use is self-serve. Accessing WABAs the app's business does not own requires Advanced access via App Review. The claim that direct use needs no App Review came from a third-party page not in the supplied text, and the supplied pages do not state it. Pricing details are not settled by the supplied pages.
blocker_notes: Serving other businesses requires App Review with Advanced access to whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging. It also requires Embedded Signup onboarding, and Tech Provider clients must supply their own payment method. The MCP claim could not be verified from the supplied pages, and the MCP registry signal was empty.

evidence.quote: If you are building an app that will not be used by other businesses, refer to our [Cloud API Get Started](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/get-started) guide instead.

If your app uses this permission to access WABAs not owned by your business, you must have **Advanced access**.
Instead, clients onboarded by Tech Providers must provide their own payment method after onboarding is complete.
Graph API calls use access tokens for authentication.
If you are a Tech Provider or Tech Partner, you should use **business tokens** exclusively.
Embedded Signup automatically generates all required WhatsApp assets for clients who successfully complete the flow, and authorizes your app to access those assets.
Programmatically manage your WhatsApp business account and its assets.
With Webhooks set up, you can receive real-time HTTP notifications from the WhatsApp Business Platform.
